title: Gnomon: Compact Cost Inspector — mini-ledger, attribution & export UX
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, role-aware token-level cost inspector (codename: Gnomon) intended for quick drilldowns inside the Redwood Console. The mini-ledger sits as a sliding panel from any route-level or model dashboard and provides: per-invocation token breakdown (prompt/completion/context), attribution to route/route-version/user, quick pricing pattern toggles (rateband, rounding, quantization adjustment), and one-click CSV/JSON export. The goal is a low-friction workflow for engineers and finance partners to answer: 'Which invocations drove the last spike?', 'How much did batching/quantization save?', and 'Export my filtered slice for chargebacks.' This ticket covers prototype screens, interaction specs, export presets, and a short usability test run with two SEs and one finance PM.
acceptance_criteria: Panel accessible from route/model action menu and via keyboard shortcut (G)
Shows per-invocation token split (input/system/context/completion) with unit cost & raw token counts
Attribution tags applied: route, model-version, user-id, invocation-id
Exported CSV contains header mapping and applied pricing pattern metadata
Pricing preset dropdown with 3 defaults (list-price, quantized, custom) and transient preview of unit changes
decisions: Use compact table rows with ellipsized prompt preview + hover-to-expand for long prompts
Include a lightweight in-memory preview of export (first 50 rows) before full export
Show computed cost delta when switching pricing presets to make trade-offs explicit

2025-02-07 — Diego Ramirez: Updated text strings and added sticky filters prototype. Edge case: very long prompts increase row height; switched to two-line truncation.
2025-02-10 — PM Review (Arjun Patel): Reviewed prototype, approved for engineering spike. Assigned ENG-3872 for backend export endpoints and PM-924 for rollout coordination.
2025-02-12 — Design Review: Minor accessibility fixes requested (contrast, keyboard focus states). Added a11y checklist to Confluence page.
next_steps: Resolve a11y items and hand off tokens mapping file to Eng (action: Diego -> ENG-3872)
Add sticky-filter persistence implementation note to PR and API contract (export_preview param)
Schedule 1-week pilot on a dedicated workspace with finance team for CSV schema validation
notes: Prototype emphasizes explainability: every pricing preset shows an inline 'why this changes cost' tooltip. Avoided embedding ratecard editor in MVP — will live in a separate 'pricing patterns' product flow.
ux_considerations: Minimal vertical footprint to avoid hiding charts — panel opens at 40% width on desktop and full-screen on mobile
Allow quick switch between 'per-invocation' and 'aggregate by user/route' via toggle
Show currency and token-unit labels prominently to reduce misinterpretation
